description: This file defines an `AuditListener` class used for handling auditing callbacks within a Java persistence context. It updates audit information such as creation and modification dates before persistence actions.

classes.name: AuditListener
classes.description: A JPA entity listener class that updates audit information before save or update operations.

methods.name: onSaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Method invoked before persisting or updating an entity to update audit timestamps.
